headline: October held September's pace: $19,936 in sales and $2,396 of net operating income
model_notes: October sales were $19,936, about level with September ($20,200) and up 51% on October 2025
Weekday traffic averaged 129 transactions a day at a $7.28 average ticket
Net operating income was $2,396, or 12.0% of sales
Labor was 36% of sales. September and October together ran 34%
Cost of goods was 30% of sales, down from 38% in September. It may be light on internal billing; month-end inventory counts started in October and should reduce the month-to-month swings
Expenses include a $1,331 espresso machine repair (the machine is fixed) and $1,340 of chemicals and dry goods. Chemical payments are batched, so they do not line up with deliveries
Year to date through October the cafe has earned $9,301 on $165,808 of sales
outlook: The model projects sales of about $14,550 in November and $12,400 in December
Full year 2026 is projected at about $10,860 of net operating income on $192,760 of sales
The slower holiday months (November through January) remain the main risk to that figure
next_steps_p3: Slipstream will continue work on holiday events and catering to balance the slower months. Nothing is booked yet
Slipstream will share a holiday gift and catering ideas flyer with the MRP team
